SideSpeed 0.6.0 adds two Tools: Turn off extras and Home screen.

## What's new
- **Turn off extras.** Turn off apps your TV maker added that you don't use. SideSpeed only turns apps off; it never uninstalls anything.
  - The list comes from the [CleanYourTV](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv) project (MIT) and only shows on a TV whose model matches a list exactly. This release has a verified list for the onn 4K Pro; other TVs show "No list for this TV yet."
  - Tick apps and press **Turn off selected**. Apps that are off, whatever turned them off, can be ticked and turned back on with **Turn on selected**.
  - **Restore everything** turns back on everything SideSpeed turned off.
  - Core system apps, setup apps, Settings, TV inputs, SideSpeed itself and your current home screen are marked **Protected** and can't be turned off.
- **Home screen.** On Google TV and Android TV, pick an installed home screen app as Home. SideSpeed remembers the home screen your TV had first, and **Back to stock** returns to it. Google TV keeps its own home screen while it's turned on; the card tells you to turn it off in Turn off extras first. On Fire TV the card only says Fire TV doesn't allow other home screens.
- SideSpeed now checks for its own updates every 6 hours instead of once a day.

**Updating:** press **Update now** on the update notice, or **About → Check for updates**. On Fire TV with SideSpeed 0.5.2 or 0.5.3, update once with Downloader (code **3503400**) or `sidespeed.app/tv`. From 0.4.0 or earlier, update once with Downloader.

Updating stops the helper, as before. On Google TV, open SideSpeed to start it again; on Fire TV, the Companion starts it.

The Companion apps have no changes in this release.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.6.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.6.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.6.0-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.6.0-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.6.0-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
